content: एष् €1 <ab>U.</ab> (एषति-ते, एषितुम्, एषित) .²1 To go or approach. .²2 To hasten towards, fly at, attack any one. .²3 To endeavour to reach or gain. .²4 To request. .²5 To desire. .²6 To creep or glide; पराङ्मित्र एषतु <ls>Av. 6. 67. 3</ls>. .²7 To know; एषितुं प्रेषितो यातो मया तस्यानुजो वनम् <ls>Bk. 5. 82</ls>.
